QCB-001.title: OpenSSL library is past upstream end of life
QCB-001.fix: Replace the library with OpenSSL 3.5 (upstream support until 2030-04-08). QNX's own port is at github.com/qnx-ports/openssl (branches qnx-openssl-3.5.4 and qnx-openssl-3.6.0). Put the new libcrypto/libssl into the image build lists in place of the SDK files, rebuild the image and scan again.
unverified: Whether QNX supplies security fixes for OpenSSL 3.0 after 2026-09-07 (the image's 3.0.22 is dated 25 Aug 2026).
QCB-001.title_ok: OpenSSL library is within upstream support

QCB-002.title: sshd does not allow post-quantum key exchange
QCB-002.fix: In the sshd_config of the image (the inline block in system.build) start the KexAlgorithms line with mlkem768x25519-sha256 and keep a classical fallback, for example: KexAlgorithms mlkem768x25519-sha256,curve25519-sha256@libssh.org,ecdh-sha2-nistp256. Rebuild the image and scan again.
unverified: That the SSH clients you use support mlkem768x25519-sha256.
The OpenSSH release that first contained the algorithm (only 10.0 was read: it made the algorithm the default).

QCB-003.title: ssh client does not allow post-quantum key exchange
QCB-003.fix: In ssh_config start KexAlgorithms with mlkem768x25519-sha256, or remove the KexAlgorithms line so the OpenSSH default (post-quantum first since 10.0) applies.
unverified: That the servers you connect to support mlkem768x25519-sha256.
QCB-003.title_ok: ssh client allows post-quantum key exchange

QCB-004.title: Key or certificate uses a quantum-vulnerable algorithm
QCB-004.fix: Plan a move to ML-DSA (FIPS 204) or SLH-DSA for signing keys once your signing path supports them. OpenSSL 3.5 can generate ML-DSA keys. Until then keep RSA at 3072 bits or more.
unverified: NIST transition dates for RSA, ECDSA and EdDSA (NIST IR 8547 draft was found but its dates were not read).
QCB-004.title_ok: Key or certificate uses a post-quantum algorithm

QCB-005.title: qcrypto sends all algorithms to a plug-in without post-quantum algorithms
QCB-005.fix: No qcrypto fix exists in SDP 8.0.6: its API has no key-encapsulation type (see evidence/T2-qcrypto-plugin.txt). Use OpenSSL 3.5 directly for post-quantum key exchange.
unverified: Whether a later QNX release adds ML-KEM or ML-DSA to qcrypto.
The QNX documentation page was not read for this rule; the claim rests on the SDK headers (evidence/T2-qcrypto-plugin.txt).

QCB-006.title: A running process loads a different OpenSSL library than the image holds
QCB-006.fix: The disk scan does not describe this process. Remove the LD_LIBRARY_PATH override that points at the other library, or put the library into the image and scan again.
unverified: No QNX documentation page is cited; the rule compares two facts the tool measured itself.
QCB-006.title_ok: A running process loads the library the image holds

QCB-007.title: A running process loads an OpenSSL library past upstream end of life
QCB-007.fix: Same as QCB-001: load OpenSSL 3.5 in this process.
QCB-007.title_ok: A running process loads an OpenSSL library within upstream support

QCB-008.title: A file that decides a verdict could not be analysed
QCB-008.fix: Make the file readable (valid ELF, readable permissions, inside the allowed folders, under 64 MiB) and scan again. Until then the verdict cannot be trusted, so the scan fails.
